raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (2026-01-18) delivered customer_id without zero-padding (e.g. 'C2', 'C139', 'C76') while the customer dimension uses 5-digit padded IDs ('C00002'). Padding the numeric part to 5 digits in silver_transactions is a deterministic mapping and also corrects gold_customer_spend.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(customer_id), '^[Cc][0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(trim(customer_id), 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
